attempts.summary: Configured PostgreSQL 16 streaming replication across node1 (primary), node2, node3 (standbys) on RHEL 10, secured with a cluster-created CA. Replication connections require a client cert signed by that CA (hostssl ... cert in pg_hba.conf); verified rejection of no-cert and wrong-CA-signed-cert connections. Verified live data replication and SSL=on for both standby connections. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes with boot_id proof of restart and post-restart recovery/quorum verification.
